sql: WITH clock AS (SELECT from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur') AS now_myt), hours AS (SELECT COALESCE(r.location_id, 0) AS location_id, t AS hour_myt, CAST(r.hourly.precipitation[i] AS DOUBLE) AS rain_mm, to_timestamp(t, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm") AS ts_myt FROM veda_wx.om_rain r LATERAL VIEW posexplode(r.hourly.time) h AS i, t) SELECT p.location_id, p.point_key, p.station_key, p.name, h.hour_myt, h.rain_mm FROM hours h CROSS JOIN clock c JOIN veda_pg.rain_points p ON p.location_id = h.location_id WHERE h.ts_myt > c.now_myt - INTERVAL 72 HOURS AND h.ts_myt <= c.now_myt + INTERVAL 72 HOURS
